course_name_original: HISTORY OF TURKISH REVOLUTION AND ATATÜRK S PRINCI
course_name_en: HISTORY OF TURKISH REVOLUTION AND ATATÜRK'S PRINCIPLES

learning_outcomes.text: Gaining the ability to analyze history-related information around the subject, time, and players.
Developing a realistic perspective by associating a historical event and a recent event
Learning to evaluate various materials such as books, articles, movies, tv series. Students will be able to evaluate different opinions critically.
Developing the ability to find and analyze opinions and ideas from history.
Expressing and conveying their thoughts correctly and gaining sympathy with the historical characters and improving the ability of thinking abstract.
Learning to comment about a historical event and to practice making an oral presentation and writing an essay.
Adopting universal values while respecting their roots.
Understanding the value of the motherland by learning the ancestors who gave their lives for the motherland and developing the awareness of national unity and togetherness.

syllabus_topics: The subjects of Atatürk`s Principles and History of Revolution Course. The course's importance, purpose and concepts related to history.
The internal and external causes of the collapsing of Ottoman Empire.
General Political Situation the social, political, and economic situation of Ottoman Empire at the beginning of 20th century. Tripoli and Balkan Wars.
The changes in the world before the First World War. The search for an alliance of Ottoman Empire, participating the war, the fronts, the losses, and the migrations during the war.
The secret agreements of the Allied Powers during the First World War and the plans to share the Ottoman territory.
The Mondros Armistice, its effect on the Empire and resulting outcomes, the occupation of Anatolia by the Allied Powers, the Ottoman Empire after the Armistice.
The harmful societies which were established to support occupations in Anatolia. Useful societies which were established to save Anatolia from foreign occupation.
Preparation for National Struggle Activities of Mustafa Kemal Pasha in Istanbul and Anatolia, Amasya Memorandum,
Erzurum Congress, Sivas Congress, Balıkesir and Alasehir Congresses
Amasya Meetings, Arrival of Committee of Representation to Ankara. Last meeting of Ottoman Parliament. The National Pact and the results.
Establishment of the Turkish National assembly. Political, social, and military developments. Revolts against the Turkish National Assembly.
